title: ‘Einstein’
description:
In the process of wanting to regularly practice drawing and portraiture in order to constantly improve not just creating but also the art of looking and seeing, I decided I wanted to fill my sketchbook with icons.
Albert Einstein is one such icon who is immediately recognisable and as such leaves no margin for error.
I’m so pleased with how this one turned out.

title: ‘Robin’
description:
As a child I used to love Mork & Mindy. Robin’s energy was fascinating and infectious. As I’ve grown through adolescence and adulthood my love of his films never faded. With Dead Poets Society being one of my stand out favourites that I go back to time and time again.
His passing was devastating and inspired me to honour him with this drawing which I truly love.
If you’re interested in this, make me an offer but if not I’m happy to cherish it.

title: ‘Uncle David’
description:
A portrait from a photo I took of my mums cousin when we went to see him last, not too long before his passing.
This one stays in my possession and reminds me of my childhood and the many times he came to stay during his leave from the Navy

title: ‘Alnwick Castle’
description: Specifically created for a donation as an auction prize at a charity ball to raise much needed funds for an amazing local charity.

title: ‘The Sarah Dessert’
description:
This was a very special gift for an amazing person.
Painted from a supplied photograph of a group of breast cancer survivors during their expedition to the Sahara, raising awareness and funds for related charities.
See more on this story on instagram.
